title: XamlGen Input Document
description: Input document for the XAML generator. Contains a project-level expression language setting and the AST root node.

expressionLanguage.description: Target expression language for all argument values in this document. Derived from project.json design.expressionLanguage. Determines which WF expression wrapper is emitted (VisualBasicValue<T> vs CSharpValue<T>).

root.description: The AST root node. May be any node kind, including a bare Activity.

ActivityNode.description: A single activity. May be a leaf or a scope-container when slots are present.

arguments.description: Argument values keyed by CLR property name (Member.name). Values are expression strings in the document's expressionLanguage. The generator does not parse or validate expression syntax — values are passed through to the WF expression activity.

slots.description: Named child positions keyed by CLR property name of Child members (memberKind: Child in engine-result). Each value is a nested AST node.

SequenceNode.description: An ordered container of child nodes.

children.description: Ordered list of child AST nodes.
